name: DateField
description: A date or date-range picker: a read-only TextField trigger that opens a calendar dialog, with an optional per-day fare slot.

provenance.tag: Rec; single/range by trip type and lowest-fare-per-day slot: A · unverified

props.name: mode
props.description: One-way uses single; return uses range.

props.name: value
props.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings, local to the departure airport. Not JS Date, which carries a time zone and can shift the day by one.

props.name: months
props.description: 2 on lg and up, 1 on smaller screens.

props.name: locale
props.description: Month and weekday names, and the first day of the week. Arabic: Gregorian calendar, Latin digits (D15).

props.name: renderDayMeta
props.description: Slot for the lowest fare per day. The feature layer passes in PriceDisplay size="sm".

props.name: getDayMetaLabel
props.description: Text version of the day meta for screen readers, e.g. "from USD 899".

states.name: selected
states.appliesTo: day cell (single, range start or end)

requirements: Trigger: a button showing the chosen date(s), named e.g. "Departure date, 12 December 2026".
The calendar opens in a dialog containing one grid per month. Each day is a gridcell with a button.
Each day's name is the full date plus its state and fare: "Friday 12 December 2026, selected, from USD 899" (getDayMetaLabel).
Recommended: also accept a typed date in the locale format. Not required for AA, because the grid is fully keyboard operable.
keyboard: Arrows move by day or week.
Page Up / Page Down move by month.
Home / End go to the start or end of the week.
In Arabic, Left and Right follow the visual direction.
announcements: Range mode: after the start date, the dialog announces "Select return date".

rtl: Gregorian calendar; week start from Intl.Locale(...).getWeekInfo() (Monday for ar-AE). Never hardcode it.
Latin digits; month and weekday names from Intl.DateTimeFormat with the page locale.
The grid mirrors; arrow keys follow the visual direction.

ambiguities.description: The 44×44 day-cell minimum has no token.
